title.narrative: Climate resilient wash services in Haiti

description.narrative: According to the WFP, Haiti has one of the highest levels of food insecurity in the world. The rural areas in the South have very limited access to clean water and latrines, The Grand Anse has one of the highest defaction rates in Haiti (55%). The risk of the populatin getting frequent water-borne diseases, is high. The focus of the programme is to build adaptive and disaster response capacity of communities in the Grand Sud, which are very vulnerable to hurricanes and other disasters due to climate change. The project will also establish climate resilient safe water services, sanitation and hygiene promotion to local communities and schools. Activities will include installation of handwashing facilities, training in hygiene and water management, as well as gender sensitive sanitation, and construction of toilets specially designed for people with mobility problems. Food security will be addressed through training in climate smart eco-farming techniques. The project will target a population of 50,000 people (29% women, 22% girls and people with diabilities, 28% men and 21% boys, which is 10,000 households. People will participate in and influence decision making about all WASH services that affect them.
